item.tib: stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis sgrub pa las dbang khrid byin rlabs sprin dpung
item.coloph: de ltar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog sgrab kyis (kyi/)smin byed byin rlabs blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud dbang gi yig chung las/ skabs kyi yig chung byin rlabs sprin dpung zhes/ sngon gyi mkhas pa gong ma'i dgongs bzhed kyi/ cha lag rgyab yig kha 'thor bsdus pa dang / dbang gi lag len bde klag (blag) gyur pa'i ('gyur ba'i) phyir/ drin chen dam pa'i bka' yi (yis) bskul ba la/ brten nas rmong (rmongs) pa rang phrug bdag gis brtsams/ dge des skal ldan rgyud khrol byin rlabs nas/ lha mchog nyid ltar gcig char thob pa dang / 'gro kun byang lam mchog der myur bsgrod shog/ zhes stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis (gi) sgrub pa la (las/)skabs kyi yig chung nor bu'i gter mdzod la/ gud du bkol ba'i dbang gi skabs kyi yig chung byin rlabs sprin dpung zhes bya ba/ bkra shis ri khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ byin che'o/
